matchups.tips: Keep your Celestial Blessing (W) to go out of his Infernal Chains (W) in time. I would recommend you to buy Doran's Ring to have enough mana for both last hiting minions and using Celestial Blessing (W). Buy Berserker's Greaves as fast as possible for the same goal.

Ahri outranges you pre level 6 + she has better mobility after level 6. There are no chances to solo kill her. Try to not die early, you scale better and Kayle will be stronger in late game. Stay behind minions to avoid her Charm (E)

Akali is dangerous after getting her ultimate. Fortunately she doesn't have big range, so try to keep safe distance and farm what you can. Buying Wit's End can be a good option against her. Stay away from her cloud W when she hides inside it since you can't auto-attack her anyway and she will deal a lot of damage to you!

Kayle is weak against Anivia because she has no proper mobility. Anivia is able to easily kill you by using her ult for slow, she stuns you after that by her Q and kills you or applies huge damage by her E + Electrocute

Annie doesn't have big range so try to keep safe distance and watch her passive when she is able to stun with her next ability. Mercury's Treads, Banshee's Veil and Wit's End are good options against her.

Remember that Aurelion Sol has great roaming potential so ping immediately after his absence or leaving the lane. I also think that movement speed is very good at this matchup, so I would recommend you to buy Berserker's Boots, Wit's End and use Corrupting potion with Time Warp Tonic
His range is bigger and he is able to control the situation the whole time. Not many options you can do alone. He will push you under the tower, so maybe you will kill him together with your jungler.

Brand has longer range and will poke you. You need to farm under tower and farm. Doran's Shield and Second Wind will help you to survive his poke in early game. You have to counter attack him after you dodged his abilities or he wasted them on minions.

Very strong opponent who can harass you all the time. You can't safely farm even by your Q. She has enough range to jump on you. She will cover herself with a shield and deal you significant damage. You will be stronger in late game, but Camille is able to make your early game really miserable. Hit her back with auto-attacks when she goes back after jumping on you. Don't stay close to her so she would not activate her Q second time to do true damage.

Horrible opponent. She is much stronger early and scales well too. Quick Silver is a good item to counter her ultimate. Doran's Shield and Second Wind will help you a lot to survive her poke early on.

The difficulty depends on how he plays. AP ChoGath is able to one shot you. You are fine until you can dodge his Q, but you cannot dodge it all the time so he will destroy you sooner or later. And he has great sustain in lane.

Use Phase Rush, buy Boots as fast as possible, be careful when you want to last hit a minion by Q and E or ranged auto attack. You are good until he pulls you by his E. Taking Ghost summoner spell instead of Teleport is good too.
She can poke you down from a distance by her Q and kill with her burst damage after. Wit's End is good against her.
Try to stay behind your minions so he would not hit you by his Q. Wit's End should be useful against Mundo since it helps to kite him and protects against Mundo's magic damage.
Ekko is an AP assassin with CC abilities, so Mercury's Treads and\or Wit's End will be helpful.
Fiora is a strong duelist with great sustain. Hug the nearest wall when she tries to activate her ultimate. She is stronger early and mid game, but lately Kayle can beat her after level 16+
Fizz is an AP assassin, so Mercury's Treads and Wit's End will be helpful. You can block his ultimate by using your own.
Galio is an AP anti-mage counter champion with a dash and taunt. AD builds will be probably better against him. Mercury's Treads and Wit's End are also helpful for protection
Good Gangplank player is a real pain in the a** who will make poke fiesta. You need sustain. Doran's Shield or Corrupting Potion and Second Wind can help to survive his poke damage.
Garen looks like a very easy match up for Kayle. But at some point of time he will be able to one shot you by using Flash+Q+E+R. Gladly he can do it just once per 5 min.

Watch his anger line that transforms him into Mega Gnar! Remember of his double jump during the transmormation and keep enough distance. It's also good to not stay close to any wall so he would not stun you by his Ultimate ability. You can attack him right after he gets back into a mini Gnar form.

Hard opponent if he stays at top lane. He has a lot of damage and self-healing so it's good to buy some healing reduction or get Ignite against him. He will probably out damage and out sustain you though. Wit'z End is a good item against him.
It's hard to say, weather Heimer is hard or just annoying opponent. You cannot get him alone when he stays in his turrets, but it's possible to kill him together with your jungler
Skilled match up to my opinion. Depends on how good the player knows his champion. Try to run away from her when she activates her ultimate. Try to kill her tentacles when possible.

You are fine until she lands her E stun on you. Then your Kayle will probably be dead. It's a very annoying and just unfun to play matchup. I prefer to ban her or get another champion against her. Dodging the game is also an option.
Same as Irelia. He is stronger early and at mid game, but with full build Kayle is probably stronger. You just need to block his stun by your ultimate and kill him afterwards

Poke fiesta and early game will be really painful. Try to constantly and unordinary move so you would dodge some of his shots. Doran's Shield or Corrupting Potion with Second Wind could ease your suffering a little bit.
Quite easy opponent to my opinion, but you can save just one person when Karthus uses his ultimate

He is a melee, but very mobile opponent with high burst magic damage. Bone Plating rune and Wit's End or even Banshee's Veil are good options to survive his burst damage so you could activate your Ultimate and give him 2-3 second of hard time pain experience.

It depends on how good is the player. Katarina has much better roam potential. You should ping like hell to your allies when you see that Kata is missing. Use wards and push waves after level 6 to force her to stay on the lane or she would lose some gold end experience. Some magic resistance would be very helpful to buy as well.
Kennen is hard before you get level 6. At levels 6 - 11 you are even. And at level 11+ Kayle is generally stronger.

Kled is a strong champion with a dash. He is especially dangerous when his W is ready to do 4 fast auto-attacks. Watch when he uses it on minions and they you can try to attack him during this small time window.
I ban her every time when I play MID. She is strong and dangerous both on the line and as a roaming champion. It's impossible to fight her back because of her mobility
Lissandra has tons of CC. You can get some runes for tenacity or buy Mercury's Treads if their team has lots of CC in general. Wit's End will protect you from her magic damage.

Another poke fiesta. Lux isn't a super hard enemy, but she is just annoying because of her range. You can block her ultimate by yours, but the problem is she can use it 3 times more than you since her ulti cooldown is super low. Doran's Shield or Corrupting potion with Second Wind can help to survive her poke early on.

Malph can be dangerous if he buys AP items with Comet. Doran's Ring and learn your Heal (W) to maximum instead of Q. Or you can try Corrupting potion + Cookies for more mana as well. Some magic resistance is also helpful.
Malzahar is not a problem if you buy some magic resistance like Wit'z End or Quick Silver to get rid of his ultimate
Maokai is a tanky gap closer with proper sustain. Mercury's Treads are crucial against both his damage and CC
The most important this is to dodge his E. Use your W for additional acceleration + rush boots

Nasus is very dangerous because he puts you into a very inconvenient situation. You either harass him and slowly going to his tower (where you become an easy target for a gang) or you play passively and Nasus is going to get 500+ stacks on his Q at 20th minute. So this is lose-lose situation when you play against him. Phase Rush and Ghost can save you and help to escape.

Horrible opponent to play against on top lane. He will all-in you all the time dealing a lot of damage and there is nothing you can fight back. He is able to get you by his Q when you try to last hit minions by your own Q. Without help of the jungler it's even hard to get experience. Gladly, Nautilus is rarely picked on top lane. Maybe there are an easy way to play against him, but it still needs to be found
Her simple combo E+Q is ideal to make Kayle's life miserable before level 6
Rare top-laner, but very strong. You need Phase Rush and boots as fast as possible
Oriana is annoying and dangerous before you get level 6. You need to survive and play carefully just like always :)
Do not stay close to his Q pillar or walls

Pantheon is very strong early on. You may try to rush Seeker's Armguard. In late you can easily destroy him in 1v1 fight, but he is dangerous in team fights because of his stun. Since Kayle cannot ult herself under the effect of heavy CC, she can be killed during this 1 sec of stun. Try to keep distance before you see him using the stun on your allies.
Keep watching the location of your Kayle and Poppy. Do not stay close to walls or tower in the way so your champ would be between a wall and Poppy

You can try to play agressively against her, especially after level 6, when she misses her abilities. If she is strong and hard to stand against, you can buy some armor like Seeker's Armguard. Try to move constantly and unordinary to increase your chances to dodge her abilities.

Very hard early. Play safe before level 6 and don't forget to ping "?????" like hell when you see Quinn is missing after she got level 6. Personally I've noticed that Kayle becomes way stronger after level 11 and some items, but Quinn is able to make her allies to win their lanes so hard, that your scaling will be useless or too low to make a difference\impact
Big and strong guy with good mobility. Bone Plating are required! If thing go rough, you can buy Seeker's Armguard as well.
Very strong opponent who has one-shot combo after level 6. Seeker's Armguard and Bone Plating can help.
Super annoying if he stays on top against Kayle. Try to stay far enough from bushes so he would not have the opportunity to jump on you. Sometimes it requires from you to give up some minions
I think there is nothing hard to play against this boy. Berserker's and Wit's End are super helpful against him.
Mercury's Treads and Wit'z End are helpful against him
Quite an easy opponent if you play with boots and Fleet Footwork to speed up your champion a little bit

Strong top-laner with a dash, temporal immunity to auto attacks and global ultimate and Kayle doesn't have heavy CC abilities to interrupt his R. If you see him flied to another lane, kill enemy minions and push your wave to his tower, so he would lose some gold and experience + you might get the gold from 1 or 2 tower plates.
Quite easy after level 6. You need all extra movement speed you can get: boots, 4% MS from Time Warp Tonic, acceleration from W. Phase Rush rune can also come in handy.

Experienced Sion mainer is a very hard opponent who can poke you down by the combination: E+Q+W. He is able to dive under your tower together with his jungler. He is rare pick, but I would recommend you just ban him if he becomes more popular. Inexperienced or not aggressive Sion is quite an easy enemy though.
Hard and annoying opponent if his player knows how to land Swain's E

Very strong champion with big damage, dash and sustain. He can steal and use your ultimate, so it will not save you from him. You need to play carefully and wait for your jungler or ending of the lane phase.
Try to block her ult by yours. Buy Wit's End to reduce her magic damage. Doran's Shield or Corrupting potion with Second Wind rune can help you survive her early poke damage.
Due to her Ultimate, Taliyah is a super roaming champion. Ping immediately when she is out of your vision. Her magic damage is also quite impressive, so you need to reduce it by Wit's End

Try to push so he would not be able to roam for free. Of course it's easier to say than to do :) Be very careful because Talon has one of the strongest level 2 in the game and he makes First Blood very often!

Very annoying and inconvenient champion. Teemo is a good counter to auto attackers. I recommend you to use Doran's Shield and Second Wind against him. And don't forget to switch your wards into Oracle Lens to find his mushrooms. Gladly Kayle outscales him hard in the late game.

Tryndamere is a nightmare both early and in the late game. You need to get Phase Rush and buy Seeker's Armguard or Plated Steelcaps as fast as possible. Additional armor gives you more life time during tower dives, so there is a chance that Tryndamere will be killed. But many times it looks like the tower is not a perfect cover. Quite often I don't stay under my tower, but I run farther in direction to the second tower.
Quite easy match up. You need some extra movement speed to dodge his Q and not be hit by his E. It would be easy if you can keep safe distance to this champion.
I don't like him. It's hard to catch him or his allies when he summons his cage. But in some game stage Veigar will be able to one shot you if he stuns you (Kayle cannot use her R during a stun)
This creature has much bigger range and can make poke fiesta
Experienced Viktor player is a hard opponent. I recommend you to buy Wit'z End.

Vladimir is a strong opponent early on since he has ranged autos and great sustain. He also scales well into the late game. You can buy Doran's Shield or Corrupting potion for having sustain as well. Another good item is Wit's End for magic resistance. Try to stay behind minions so Vladimir would not hit you by his E bloody shots.

This big bear is tough. You cannot stay against him in close fight, so try to keep your distance. You need to buy boots as fast as possible. Runes Fleet Footwork and Time Warp Tonic (with Corruption Potion) can be helpful for additional acceleration
Annoying gap closer who will harass you and run, harass and run, again and again. Seeker's Armguard and Bone Plating are helpful against him.
His range is huge. Kayle has no chances to get close enough to him. You can just try to increase your sustain by using Doran's Shield or Corrupting potion with Second Wind rune.

Yasuo is a hard opponent if he is played by an experienced player. He has a good mobility + high damage. He is able to block all your Q, E and auto attacks by his wall. I think Yasuo is easy at Iron and Bronze, even opponent at Silver and Gold and he is definitely pain in the a** at Platinum and higher elos
You need to have maximum movement speed against this guy to dodge his E or to run fast enough to not allow him to put you in the Dark Procession (W)

Be careful at level 5. After getting level 6 firstly Zed will try to kill you. I would recommend you to take Bone Plating + buy some armor after the first back. Lately he is not so dangerous for you if your ultimate is ready to be used

Same as Xerath. Huge range so it's near impossible to come close enough to attack him + he is able to throw you back a little bit. But it's also hard for him to kill you. It is just an inconvenient match up

Zoe is a champion with huge range and she is able to sleep and one shot your Kayle. You can try to take and use Cleanse to get rid of her sleep. Magical items would be helpful as well. The problem is that a part of her damage is true damage

It's going to be hard time before level 6. Lucian will do all his best to poke you down. He has better damage in skirmishes and dashes for better mobility. Play carefully before level 6 and try to farm only. Kayle scales better and you will be able to destroy him after you buy Nashor's Tooth at level 11+ if he is not fed till this moment.

Play carefully before level 6 and try to clean minion waves as fast as possible after level 6. You will get good power increase when you get ranged attack + ult. And what gets Twisted Fate? Just a teleport which doesn't do damage to you. But you need to push and try to make Twisted Fate to be sticked to his tower. Put him in a situation that he will lose gold and experience from his minions if he flies away by using his ultimate.

Gwen is melee and her abilities have low range, but she has lots of dashes just like Fiora has. You can try to kite her. Berserker's Boots, Wit's End, your W and additional acceleration from Corrupting potion can greatly help you with kiting her.

Vex is a very annoying champion because of her CC and pretty decent damage. I prefer to focus on farming against her and attack her only when she missed or wasted her abilities. Don't overextend on the lane with low HP and your Ult on cooldown.

He is such a pain in the a**, especially at TOP lane. He has stronger early game trades and ability to engage from big distances, so its very hard for Kayle to farm if the minion wave is heading toward his tower. You will probably need help of your jungler to break freezed lane. But after buying Nashor's Tooth and getting level 11+ Kayle will be stronger than him if he is not fed till that moment.
